selection: Extend the existing admitted owner and its managed standing trigger; no new owner or admission.

behavioral_evaluation.agents: Two fresh GPT-6.1 Sol agents at medium reasoning, author then independent continuation
behavioral_evaluation.loading: The lifecycle guide was explicitly loaded; spontaneous retrieval was not measured.
behavioral_evaluation.casual_idea: One comparative paragraph; no project or files created.
behavioral_evaluation.existing_project: Only the whitespace-counting bug changed; existing README and project reused; command and boundary checks passed.
behavioral_evaluation.growing_thread: Created a conventional CLI project, retained input/evidence references, linked one handoff and passed three implementation tests.
behavioral_evaluation.concurrent_work: Unrelated ongoing file preserved; only explicitly owned stale preview archived using the real helper with verified recovery hash.
behavioral_evaluation.continuation: Fresh agent used only the project handoff and files to implement a repeatable exclusion flag; four tests passed, default outputs and input CSV byte-identical.
behavioral_evaluation.limitation: Bounded task evidence, no A/B quality comparison or universal reliability claim. Initial Windows mode-700 temporary-directory failures were corrected with ordinary project-local test directories.

automation_evidence.breadcrumb_cli: 13 regression tests passed; existing schema unchanged.
automation_evidence.artifact_helper: 14 cases: 13 passed and one symlink-creation test skipped because this host lacks that privilege. Exact-path ownership, preview, unchanged-file archive/restore, concurrency, interruption, malformed-record and collision cases tested. Windows junction refusal separately passed with target bytes preserved.
automation_evidence.source_guards: Nine renderer tests and 18 instruction-profile tests passed; generated overlays, profile budgets and full recovery snapshot verified. Two skills passed metadata validation.
automation_evidence.codex_adapter: Seven unit cases passed. Disposable CODEX_HOME native RPC and independent-process helper readback persisted membership and reused the root, preserving cwd. Zero inference calls and no real user thread/project changes.
automation_evidence.native_unsupported_case: An empty thread without a persisted rollout refused metadata update. Synthetic seeding was used only in the disposable test profile and is prohibited as a production fallback.
automation_evidence.native_skill_review: Only the reconfirmation paragraph changed through the Hermes staged review/approval queue; deletion guards retained. Fresh native skill_view readback matched the reviewed file.

retirements.directive_removed: Hermes session-librarian's blanket duplicate consent requirement for already-authorized reversible mutations
useful_capabilities_retained: existing frontend guidance and accepted evidence

limits: Model guidance is responsible for scope decisions, ownership and loading the owner; no autonomous watcher was installed.
Filesystem organization and native membership are distinct; the helper does not move files or change thread cwd, sandbox access or active UI selection.
Native Codex project API is experimental; membership has no atomic compare-and-set, so preflight/readback cannot prevent every noncooperating concurrent writer.
Hermes live session movement and Codex UI refresh were not tested; OMP automatic behavior was not established.
Recovery flags are caller assertions, not inferred completion/reference checks or deletion authorization.
